title: Identify the Largest Outlier in an Array
summary: Given an integer array nums with n elements, where exactly n-2 elements are special numbers, one element is the sum of these special numbers, and one element is an outlier, identify the outlier.
statement: Given an integer array nums with n elements, where exactly n-2 elements are special numbers, one element is the sum of these special numbers, and one element is an outlier, identify the outlier. An outlier is defined as a number that is neither one of the special numbers nor the sum of these special numbers. Return the largest outlier in the array nums.
constraints: nums has at least three integers and contains n-2 special entries, their sum as another entry, and one outlier.
Values and roles are index-based, so duplicate numeric values may fill different roles.
Return the largest value that can serve as the outlier.
hints: After removing an outlier x, the remaining total must equal twice the designated sum value.
Test every distinct candidate with a frequency map and preserve separate occurrences when values coincide.
Let remaining=total-x; if it is even and remaining/2 still occurs, update the maximum x.
The equation is necessary, and the remaining occurrence check constructs the required sum role, making it sufficient.
editorial: The equation is necessary, and the remaining occurrence check constructs the required sum role, making it sufficient.

The first three values sum to negative six, leaving four as the outlier.
